source_name: Kosárérték.hu - Worldline company profile (retail/payments trade portal)
why_relevant: Hungarian retail-trade portal maintaining company profile pages for acquirers, aggregating their Hungarian announcements and merchant-facing claims; a useful pointer into Hungarian merchant-side coverage of the acquiring layer.

entity_name: MarketScreener / financial-news mirrors of MBH and OTP flash reports
source_name: MarketScreener / financial-news mirrors of MBH and OTP flash reports
why_relevant: Useful as a low-latency English alerting layer and for spotting that a filing exists; not authoritative and licence-restricted, so use it as a trigger to fetch the primary document from the issuer or BÉT/MNB.

source_name: Origo / HVG company tag pages (cimke) for financial actors
why_relevant: General-press per-company tag feeds capture press-release-derived coverage and, importantly, corporate reactive statements during incidents (outages, fraud) that never reach the corporate newsroom. Useful redundancy layer against newsrooms that delete old items.

High-reach portal that carries bank quarterly-result stories, frequently close to the bank's own press release wording — useful as a press-release mirror when the bank's IR page is unstable. Editorial independence is contested, so use for factual figure/timestamp capture only, not interpretation.

entity_name: BNP Paribas Personal Finance corporate site
source_name: BNP Paribas Personal Finance corporate site (historical Cetelem Hungary layer)
why_relevant: Still useful for the pre-2024 history of Magyar Cetelem and for BNP Paribas' remaining Hungarian footprint (BNP Paribas Budapest branch, corporate & institutional banking), which is disclosed only at a coarse geography level in BNP's Universal Registration Document.

source_name: Cash-Atm Banktechnikai Kft. – Hungarian independent ATM operator
why_relevant: Local independent ATM deployer/operator doing nationwide ATM operation and site management — a likely counterparty for banks delegating small-settlement ATM obligations. Only a social page surfaced, so a corporate site is unconfirmed.

source_name: Cbonds issuer page — BNP Paribas Budapest
why_relevant: Aggregator holding issuer profiles, credit ratings and accounting/financial report tables for Hungarian bank entities of foreign groups. Useful as a cross-check on entity identity and reporting history where the parent gives little country detail. Partly paywalled.

Hungarian company-data aggregator with per-entity profile pages that persist after corporate rebrands (e.g. it still carries the Bisnode D&B Magyarorszag identity for the renamed D&B Hungary entity). Useful as a redundancy layer and for legacy-name resolution when a Hungarian bank entity has been merged away.

entity_name: Commercial resellers of Hungarian filing data
source_name: Commercial resellers of Hungarian filing data (adatbazisok.hu 'Közzétett beszámolók és mérlegek adatbázisa' and similar)
why_relevant: Third-party vendors repackage the e-beszámoló corpus into structured, queryable financial databases. Faster than parsing PDFs for large-scale screening of payments-sector companies, but derived data with vendor-specific coverage and normalisation caveats — treat as convenience layer, not source of truth.

Designs and manufactures purpose-built devices for IT, banking and customer-service use (queue-management systems, information kiosks) — a domestic supplier layer to bank branch transformation projects.

Business-economics portal ('a vállalkozások gazdasági iránytűje') publishing independent economic and financial news/analysis. Named in the cell definition; confirmed live as a business/finance outlet, but no bank-earnings-specific article was surfaced in this run — relevance to A1 earnings coverage remains to be validated.

source_name: Other Hungarian company-document resellers (onlineceginformacio.hu, cegjegyzek.hu, cegkivonat.com, cegtalalo.hu)
why_relevant: A cluster of resellers drawing on the same e-cegjegyzek / Ceginformacios Szolgalat backend, offering instant HU/EN/DE/FR certified extracts and multi-year Excel financials. Worth tracking as fallback access routes when the official portal is slow or a specific historical filing is hard to locate, and as a signal of what document types are commercially demanded.

Smaller Hungarian company-intelligence aggregator with per-entity pages; useful as a third redundancy layer for entity resolution and for spotting which HU financial-sector entities are actively monitored commercially. Lower authority than Opten or D&B.

entity_name: SIX Payment Services Hungary legacy site
source_name: SIX Payment Services Hungary legacy site (six-payment-services.com/hu)
why_relevant: Legacy brand estate still serving Hungarian merchants and documenting the pre-Worldline acquiring footprint (present in Hungary since 2009, 11,000+ merchants). Useful for historical continuity and for merchant-contract terms that still reference the old entity.
